blocking_findings.reason: Final activity/toxicity evidence is not publication-grade source coverage. Source paragraph xml:p:32 and PDF page 8 report nisin no inhibition against E. coli across 0-533.3 µg/mL, nisin MIC 266.7 µg/mL against S. aureus, P-AgNPs MIC 533.3 µg/mL against both strains, and NP-AgNPs2 MIC 16.7/33.3 µg/mL against E. coli/S. aureus. The final keeps only the nisin S. aureus MIC. Source toxicity paragraphs xml:p:44-45 and PDF pages 11-12 report nisin NIH-3T3 viability range, NP-AgNPs2/P-AgNPs NIH-3T3 values 77.3/18.2% at 0.4 mg/mL, and HCT-116 values 62.6/83.2% at 0.2 mg/mL; the final omits these NP/P and HCT-116 records and adds a generic mammalian-cell nisin 95.2% row unsupported by the cited locator. The accepted S. aureus activity row also says strain_or_isolate not reported while target_species embeds strain 186335.
